arabic text: Machawo shor na logo sakina Jaag Jayengi\nMeri Zanjeer Na Khencho sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: Do not make a noise, people—Sakina will wake.\nDo not pull my chains—Sakina will wake

arabic text: Kabhi Bachi ko takta hai kabhi aansoo(n) bahata hai\nDar-e-Zindan se behta musafir sabse kehtaa hai\nzaraa aaram se guzro sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: Sometimes he gazes at the child, sometimes he sheds tears.\nAt the prison door, the traveller tells everyone:\nPlease pass quietly—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Kisi bhi Zulm ke jo aah ki khatir wo lab khulte\nTarap ker Abid-e-bimar ye kehta thaa hoto se\nagar ye aah nikli to sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: Whenever his lips opened to sigh beneath another cruelty,\nthe ailing Abid would cry out in anguish:\nIf this sigh escapes, Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Agar Aulaad wale ho tumhe ye sab pataa hoga\nadhoori neendh se uth jaye jo bachi to kiya hoga\nkhudara shimr ko roko sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: Parents will understand what this means:\nwhat will happen if a child wakes before her sleep is complete?\nFor God’s sake, stop Shimr—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Abhi Zindan me hojayi ga kohraam ye barpa\nwho aahat simt ke samjegi ke shayed aa gaye baba\nDar-e-Zindan naa kholo sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: An uproar will break out in the prison even now.\nAt the sound, she will think perhaps her father has arrived.\nDo not open the prison door—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Ye wadaa hai meraa pani nahi mangooga me tum se\nwo jab uthtjaya to jee bhar ke beshak maar na dure\nabhi bekas ko na maro sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: I promise I will not ask you for water.\nWhen she wakes, you may beat me as much as you wish.\nDo not strike this helpless one now—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Abhi azad ho tum qayd ke matlab ko kiya jano\nparindo chordo zindan meri iltejaa maango\nchale jawoo naa yu chehko sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: You are free; what do you know of captivity?\nRelease the birds from their cages—this is my plea.\nGo away and do not chirp—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Sar-e-Zinda sakina ko kazaa ki neend kiyaa aayi\nkisi se kuch nahi kehtaa hai itna mazloom thaa bhayi\nke ab ye der nahi usko sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: When Sakina fell into the sleep of death in the prison,\nher brother, so oppressed, said nothing more than this:\nThere is no longer any fear that Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Agar Aulaad wale ho tumhe ye sab pataa hoga\nadhoori neendh se uth jaye jo bachi to kiya hoga\nkhudara shimr ko roko sakina Jaag Jayengi
english translation text: Parents will understand what this means:\nwhat will happen if a child wakes before her sleep is complete?\nFor God’s sake, stop Shimr—Sakina will wake.

arabic text: Saf-e-matam se abid ka ye "Akbar" bayn aata hai\nIsse bas waaste purse meri ab cheyn aata hai\nSada matam ki na roko, Sakina jaag jayengi
english translation text: From the rows of mourners comes this lament of Abid, says Akbar:\nOnly through the consolation offered here does my heart find peace.\nNever stop the sound of matam—Sakina will wake.
